name: publicWeb_createMember
description: Web self-signup (E9.F7.S3): a hasher whose email the kennel never recorded becomes a member by answering the run notice. Validates the request, refuses an address that already has a live account (10005, the app signup's contractual duplicate code), resolves @kennelSlug to a kennel, then EXECs HC6.hcapp_addEditUser in new-user mode (@deviceId NULL — creation only, no token) with @followKennelOnAddNewUser = 1 so the new hasher follows that kennel; hcapp_addEditUser's rowsets are returned as they come. The email is NOT proven here: the web next sends the invite code and the browser becomes a device only when the code comes back (hcapp_authorizeDevice), exactly as the app's flow. No SP-level auth: reachable only through PublicWebAdminApi behind HC_INTERNAL_SECRET.

parameters.name: kennelSlug
parameters.description: The kennel whose link was tapped (case-insensitive match on KennelUniqueShortName, deleted = 0). NULL or unknown → the empty GUID, i.e. no kennel is followed.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always first. This SP's own refusals and hcapp_addEditUser's SuccessEnvelope share the shape.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: 1220 missing email / hash name; 10005 email already registered; 1500 unhandled (CATCH); otherwise hcapp_addEditUser's code (NULL on success).

rowsets.description: After a 1220 or 10005 envelope (errorId is a fresh NEWID() with no HC.ErrorLog row; no debugMessage column), or hcapp_addEditUser's ErrorDetail. The 1500 CATCH envelope has NO detail rowset.

rowsets.name: NewUserProfile
rowsets.description: On success, as returned by HC6.hcapp_addEditUser in new-user mode: Only returned when success=1 AND new-user mode (@deviceId IS NULL, or @userId resolved to null-UUID). Returns the newly created Hasher record directly instead of delegating to a sync SP.

columns.name: dispName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName computed column, coalesced to empty string.

columns.name: preferences
columns.description: Hasher.Preferences cast to NVARCHAR — string representation of the INT bitfield.

sideEffects: EXEC HC6.hcapp_addEditUser in new-user mode — its side effects: INSERT HC.Hasher, INSERT HC.LaunchAndLogin, INSERT HC.HasherKennelMap for the resolved kennel (followKennelOnAddNewUser = 1), INSERT HC.ErrorLog on its error paths.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog in this SP's CATCH (no re-throw; returns the 1500 envelope).

codeSmells.issue: Unknown kennel slug signs up silently without a kennel
codeSmells.detail: Lines 53-57: a slug that matches no kennel (or a removed one — only deleted is checked) leaves @kennelId as the empty GUID, so the hasher is created following nothing and the page reports success.

codeSmells.issue: Refusal errorId has no ErrorLog row
codeSmells.detail: Lines 35 and 46 return errorId = NEWID() for 1220 / 10005 without logging it.
1220 (missing details) is also the ValidateAppAuth failure code for spNumber 120 (hcapp_deletePasskey). Different SPs, so not ambiguous in practice, but it breaks the one-code-one-meaning convention.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
